description: Every Pin Generator MCP tool as a typed command, with credit-safe dry runs, preflight pricing and a local spend ledger.

tools.name: mcp_rpc
tools.description: Send a raw JSON-RPC request to the Pin Generator MCP endpoint. tools/call can spend credits; prefer the typed commands, which dry-run by default. Required: jsonrpc (default: 2.0), id (default: 1), method (default: tools/list). Optional: params.

params.name: id
params.description: Request id echoed in the response

novel_features.name: Post to pin
novel_features.description: Turn a blog post URL into a scheduled Pinterest pin in one command, previewed for free before any credit is spent.

novel_features.name: Plan preflight
novel_features.description: Price a planned batch in credits and confirm the profile, board and design profile exist before spending anything.

novel_features.name: Products to pins
novel_features.description: Turn a connected store's products into a batch of scheduled pins, skipping products already pinned.

novel_features.name: Unpinned posts
novel_features.description: List sitemap posts that have no scheduled pin and no ledgered spend.

novel_features.name: Spend ledger
novel_features.description: See every credit-spending call this CLI executed, with totals by tool and time window.

novel_features.name: Queue gaps
novel_features.description: Find empty and overloaded days in the scheduled-pin queue, per board.

novel_features.name: Credit runway
novel_features.description: Estimate weekly credit burn from active automations and how many days of credit remain.
